## Summary
Senior Full Stack Developer and Technical Team Leader with over 8 years of experience in the IT industry, specializing in modern web and mobile applications. Extensive expertise in React.js, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, and Firebase. Proven track record in architectural design, team leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and delivering scalable enterprise and consumer applications.

- **Payments**: Stripe, Razorpay, Google In-App Purchases, Apple In-App Purchases

- **Git Pull Watched**: VS Code extension that automatically runs database migrations and scripts following git pull.
- **React Native SMS Module**: Modern React Native TurboModule for Android to query, filter, and monitor incoming SMS messages.
- **Distinct**: Live Data Intelligence platform for Global Brands with real-time valuation intelligence and AWS Rekognition. Built at Jeavio. Web: https://distinct.so/
